poster.alt: Three dots, a JWT story: header, payload, and signature — the three parts of every JSON Web Token

card1.alt: JWT header in JSON: alg HS256 and typ JWT — public, readable, sets the algorithm

card2.alt: JWT payload showing sub, role, exp claims — plaintext, not encrypted, readable by anyone

card3.alt: JWT signature as HMAC SHA256 over header and payload with the secret — same input same output
